title: Desk shoulder release
description: Ease tension without leaving your chair.
steps: Sit tall with both feet flat on the floor.
Roll both shoulders backward slowly, then forward slowly.
Reach one arm across the chest, hold gently, then switch sides.
safetyNotes: Keep the stretch gentle and avoid pulling on the neck.
Stop if you feel sharp pain, tingling or dizziness.
demoInstruction: Use the shoulder release illustration as a static guide for the seated posture.

title: Seated neck roll
description: Slow neck rolls to loosen stiffness from screen focus.
steps: Sit upright and relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Slowly tilt your head to one side and pause for a comfortable breath.
Return to centre, then repeat on the other side without forcing the range.
safetyNotes: Move slowly and avoid full circles if your neck feels sensitive.
Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or nerve-like symptoms.
demoInstruction: Follow the static neck mobility description if no video demonstration is available.

title: Standing spine twist
description: Gentle rotational stretch to relieve a stiff lower back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Place your hands lightly across your chest or on your hips.
Rotate gently from side to side, keeping the movement controlled.
safetyNotes: Do not twist into pain or force your lower back.
Use a smaller range if you feel unsteady.
demoInstruction: Use the written steps as a static alternative for the standing twist.

title: Chair hip flexor stretch
description: Open up tight hips after long periods of sitting.
steps: Sit near the front of a stable chair.
Slide one foot slightly back while keeping your chest lifted.
Hold the gentle hip stretch, then repeat on the other side.
safetyNotes: Use a stable chair and keep one foot grounded.
Stop if you feel knee, hip or lower-back pain.
demoInstruction: Use the static chair setup instructions to understand the stretch safely.

title: Wrist and finger release
description: Mobilise wrists and fingers after typing or mouse use.
steps: Extend one arm forward with the palm facing away.
Use the other hand to gently stretch the fingers back.
Circle both wrists slowly, then shake out the hands.
safetyNotes: Keep pressure light and avoid pulling through pain.
Stop if you feel numbness, tingling or wrist irritation.
demoInstruction: Use the written hand positions as the static demonstration.

title: 20-20-20 eye reset
description: Look 20 feet away for 20 seconds to reduce screen eye strain.
steps: Look away from the screen toward something far away.
Keep your gaze relaxed for repeated 20-second intervals.
Blink slowly and soften your focus before returning to the screen.
safetyNotes: Do not stare into bright light or the sun.
Seek advice if eye strain is severe, sudden or persistent.
demoInstruction: Use the static instruction text because this activity does not require movement video.

title: Box breathing reset
description: A short paced-breathing cycle to lower stress before your next task.
steps: Sit comfortably with your shoulders relaxed.
Inhale for four counts, hold for four, exhale for four, then hold for four.
Repeat the cycle at a calm pace until the break ends.
safetyNotes: Return to normal breathing if you feel light-headed.
Keep the breath comfortable rather than forcing deep breaths.
demoInstruction: Use the paced breathing text as the static guide.

title: Standing desk mobility flow
description: A short standing sequence to loosen shoulders, spine, and hips together.
steps: Stand beside your desk with enough clear space.
Move through gentle shoulder rolls, spine bends and hip circles.
Finish with a slow full-body reach and relaxed breathing.
safetyNotes: Keep the range comfortable and controlled.
Clear nearby obstacles before starting.
demoInstruction: Use the static sequence description as a guide for the mobility flow.

title: Calf raise set
description: Standing calf raises to boost circulation after sitting still.
steps: Stand tall near a wall or desk for light balance support.
Lift your heels slowly, pause briefly, then lower with control.
Repeat in small sets and rest whenever needed.
safetyNotes: Hold support if balance feels uncertain.
Stop if you feel calf, ankle or foot pain.
demoInstruction: Use the static standing description as a safe setup guide.

title: Wall push-up set
description: A low-impact strength set using a nearby wall, no equipment needed.
steps: Stand facing a stable wall with hands at chest height.
Step back slightly and bend your elbows to move toward the wall.
Press back to standing tall and repeat at a steady pace.
safetyNotes: Keep wrists comfortable and shoulders relaxed.
Stop if you feel shoulder, wrist or chest discomfort.
demoInstruction: Use the static wall setup instructions if no movement video is available.

title: Seated cat-cow stretch
description: Alternating spine flexion and extension to relieve back stiffness.
steps: Sit near the front of your chair with feet flat.
Round your upper back gently while tucking your chin slightly.
Lift your chest and soften your shoulder blades back, then repeat slowly.
safetyNotes: Keep the movement gentle and avoid forcing your spine.
Stop if you feel back pain or dizziness.
demoInstruction: Use the static seated spine movement instructions as the demonstration.

title: Shoulder and chest opener
description: Counter forward-hunched posture from desk work.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands loosely behind your back if comfortable.
Draw your shoulders gently back and open the chest.
Release, roll the shoulders, and repeat with relaxed breathing.
safetyNotes: Avoid forcing your arms behind you.
Stop if you feel shoulder pain or tingling.
demoInstruction: Use the static chest-opening posture instructions as the guide.

title: Guided mindful breathing
description: A slightly longer breathing practice for a deeper mental reset.
steps: Sit comfortably and place both feet on the floor.
Notice your breathing without trying to change it at first.
Slowly lengthen each exhale and return attention when your mind wanders.
safetyNotes: Breathe naturally if paced breathing feels uncomfortable.
Pause if you feel light-headed or anxious.
demoInstruction: Use the written breathing prompts as the static guide.

title: Office stair step-ups
description: Use a nearby staircase for a quick heart-rate boost.
steps: Find a clear stair or stable step and hold the rail if available.
Step up with one foot, bring the other foot up, then step down carefully.
Alternate leading legs and keep the pace comfortable.
safetyNotes: Use a handrail and avoid crowded stair areas.
Stop if you feel short of breath, dizzy or unsteady.
demoInstruction: Use the static stair safety instructions before starting.

title: Posture reset routine
description: A short set of movements to realign posture before your next meeting.
steps: Stand tall and gently stack ears, shoulders, hips and ankles.
Roll shoulders back, lightly brace your core, and soften your knees.
Hold the reset posture while taking several slow breaths.
safetyNotes: Do not lock your knees or force your back into an arch.
Sit down if standing feels uncomfortable.
demoInstruction: Use the static posture checklist as the demonstration.

title: Full body desk circuit
description: A longer low-impact circuit combining stretch and light strength moves.
steps: Clear space around your desk and start with gentle marching.
Move through wall push-ups, calf raises and shoulder rolls.
Finish with relaxed breathing and a short posture reset.
safetyNotes: Keep the pace moderate and take breaks as needed.
Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness.
demoInstruction: Use the static circuit list to follow each movement in order.

title: Extended mobility flow
description: A 10-minute sequence covering neck, shoulders, spine, and hips.
steps: Start with slow neck turns and shoulder rolls.
Add gentle spine twists, hip circles and ankle movements.
Repeat the flow calmly, keeping each movement smooth.
safetyNotes: Stay within a comfortable range of motion.
Skip any movement that irritates a joint or injury.
demoInstruction: Use the static mobility sequence as the demonstration guide.

title: Indoor brisk walk loop
description: A brisk walking loop around your floor or building corridor.
steps: Choose a clear indoor route such as a corridor or open floor area.
Walk at a brisk but conversational pace.
Slow down for the final minute and return safely to your workspace.
safetyNotes: Watch for people, doors and wet floors.
Slow down or stop if you feel breathless or unsteady.
demoInstruction: Use the static route safety checklist before walking.

title: Meditation and breathwork
description: A longer guided session for stress reduction and mental clarity.
steps: Sit comfortably and let your hands rest naturally.
Follow a slow breathing rhythm while relaxing your jaw and shoulders.
Spend the final minute noticing how your body feels before returning to work.
safetyNotes: Keep breathing natural and avoid holding the breath too long.
Stop if the practice increases stress or discomfort.
demoInstruction: Use the static guided text as the meditation prompt.

title: Lower body strength set
description: Bodyweight squats and lunges to build strength during a longer break.
steps: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and clear space around you.
Complete slow bodyweight squats, then step-back lunges if comfortable.
Rest between sets and finish with gentle leg shaking.
safetyNotes: Keep knees comfortable and avoid deep ranges if they hurt.
Use support or choose another activity if balance feels uncertain.
demoInstruction: Use the static lower-body setup instructions before starting.
